data.name: svdemo
data.yaml:
name: svdemo
environment: staging
repo: github.com/JuanBaez77/status-sv-demo
branch: main
runtime: systemd
workdir: /srv/svdemo
run_as: svdemo
env_file: /etc/status-sv/env/svdemo.env
required_env: [SECRET_KEY]
service:
  command: [.venv/bin/gunicorn, app:app, --bind, 127.0.0.1:18097]
site:
  domain: svdemo.extendsystem.com
  port: 18097
